up: Extract the raw activity metadata for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614281. Include the following fields for each activity record: molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, relation, value, units, bao_endpoint, assay_type, and target ID. Return all rows associated with this assay.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.bao_endpoint, ass.assay_type, ass.tid FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614281'
